mapper.select: SELECT u.id, u.username, u.status, u.nickname, u.avatar, u.gender, u.employee_no, ud.is_primary, ud.status AS relation_status FROM user_dept ud INNER JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = ud.user_id WHERE ud.dept_id = #{deptId} AND ud.status IN (1, 2) ORDER BY ud.is_primary DESC, ud.create_time DESC, u.username
SELECT p.id, p.post_code, p.post_name, p.status FROM sys_post p WHERE p.dept_id = #{deptId} AND p.is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY p.order_num, p.post_code
